name: Saffron Tartan Utility Kilt - Irish Saffron Kilt
description:
Saffron Tartan Utility Kilt

Saffron Tartan Utility Kilt is fashioned with high-quality Acrylic wool. It is an excellent option to add functionality to your wardrobe with a classic design. It is a versatile addition to traditional clothing, perfect for an individual style. The front apron of the kilt is smooth, containing buttons on the top for fastening. It comes with an attractive natural colour. It has buckle straps that provide an adjustable fit. It features side-flapped pockets for your belongings to store inside. These pockets have flaps closed by buttons to secure your items while walking. It has a pleated pattern on its back and sides that shows its traditional style. A button flap on its rear gives it a modern look.

Irish Saffron Utility Kilt is suitable for a variety of events. It can be worn on Formal and Informal occasions. Whether you are attending a Scottish Wedding or an outing with friends, it is an ideal choice. All sizes are available at a low price to make them accessible to everyone. It is handmade and designed to be stylish along with traditional Tartan. Order now to get a fantastic kilt with its beauty.

Design and Specifications:

  • Material: Acrylic Wool.
  • Style: Utility.
  • Fabric: Tartan.
  • Type: Fashion/Casual.
  • Front Apron: Plain.
  • Backside: Pleated design with a buttoned flap.
  • Pattern: Check pattern.
  • Pattern colour: Saffron.
  • Availability: All sizes

Size and Measurement:

If your waist size has an even number, such as 30, 32, or 36, order your correct size. In other cases, order one larger size for a better, more comfortable fit. If you prefer a tighter fit, order one size smaller than yours. Please order one size larger or your exact size for tapered slim-fit kilts because it will fit you more than the regular ones. If you don’t know your size or are confused about size measurement, we offer Kilt Measuring Guide

Customization:

If you want to order a kilt in a particular size, Tartan, or Colour that is not shown in our list, then you can email us or contact us through the Chat Box or Call to get a perfect kilt that will match your preferences.

Note:

  • If you order a kilt whose waist size is less than 26, then this is not possible to add pockets in this selected design due to the size limitations. So please remember it while ordering.
  • In some cases, the colour shade may vary between the patterns. We try our best to deliver the product in the same colour as in the picture on our website. If a few changes happen, we request some shade fluctuation.
